name: "Check iOS Compile"

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [dev]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ios-compile-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  compile-ios:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platform-tools'
          log-accepted-android-sdk-licenses: false
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v5
      - name: Inspect build environment
        run: |
          java -version
          xcodebuild -version
          uname -m
          chmod +x gradlew
      - name: Prepare resources and Apple version
        run: ./gradlew composeApp:exportLibraryDefinitions composeApp:updateAppleBuildVersion --console=plain
      # 覆盖真机 Kotlin/Native 优化链接，不归档、不签名、不上传。
      - name: Link iOS arm64 Release framework
        run: ./gradlew composeApp:linkReleaseFrameworkIosArm64 --console=plain
      # 通过现有 Xcode Build Phase 编译模拟器 framework，并验证 Swift 宿主集成。
      - name: Build simulator app without signing
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p build/reports/ios
          xcodebuild \
            -project iosApp/iosApp.xcodeproj \
            -scheme iosApp \
            -configuration Debug \
            -sdk iphonesimulator \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            -derivedDataPath build/ios-derived-data \
            -resultBundlePath build/reports/ios/SimulatorBuild.xcresult \
            ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY= DEVELOPMENT_TEAM= PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER= \
            build 2>&1 | tee build/reports/ios/xcodebuild.log
      - name: Upload iOS diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ios-compile-diagnostics
          path: |
            build/reports/ios/
            build/reports/problems/
          if-no-files-found: warn

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
